meta.comment: engine.fuel (MOD-062, §49 Vehicles, Fuel & the EV Transition). This file is the sole data source for the fleet-composition EV-share-by-era curve, the fuel-demand figures, the hour-of-day charging profile, the strategic-reserve sizing, the fuel-duty rate, the forecourt-coverage target, and the port tank-farm tanker throughput — GR#15: no fuel figure lives as a Go literal in internal/engine/fuel/*.go.
meta.placeholderConvention: Every numeric field carries a sibling comment naming its source category — 'directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass)', 'literature-grounded placeholder (UK published figure, mapping sanity-check only)', or 'spec-transcribed' — per ASM-307's EV-share-curve / strategic-reserve-sizing data-driven-placeholder ruling and the balance-number regime (Aaron: player-felt numbers are placeholders + directional tests; no final magnitude is decided here).
meta.specRefs: §49 (fleet shift car→van→truck, trucks last; fuel as a JIT commodity whose shortage strands the logistics that fix shortages; strategic reserve buildable; fat fuel-duty line; EV transition charging stack home/street/rapid/depot/forecourt-conversion; mass EV + electric heating + no storage = winter peak crisis); §50 (port tank farm / refinery tanker supply).

eras.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): near-zero EV penetration, trucks last.

Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): near-complete car transition, trucks electrify last and incompletely.

fuelDemand.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): litres of liquid fuel per tick (day) per segment at 0% EV, plus the logistics fleet's own fuel burn (the tanker trucks that replenish other commodities). EV share reduces each segment's liquid-fuel burn to (1 - EVshare) × its figure.

chargingProfile.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): hour-of-day EV charging weights, index 0 = hour 00:00-00:59 ... index 23 = hour 23:00-23:59. Evening-peak concentrated (peak at 18:00-20:00, hour 19 highest) rather than a flat daily average — the §49 winter-crisis evening peak. baseKWhPerTick is the total daily charging load; the hourly load is baseKWhPerTick × weight[hour] / sum(weight).

strategicReserve.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): strategic-reserve sizing in days of liquid-fuel cover at current demand — §49's 'strategic reserve is a buildable'. The reserve LEVEL (litres) is runtime state; daysOfCover sizes a full reserve.

duty.comment: Literature-grounded placeholder (UK fuel duty 52.95p/litre, mapping sanity-check only, pending Aaron's balance pass). taxInstrument names the engine.tax instrument fuel duty posts through: fuel is import-only (§6/§8, engine.market.md AC-3), so its duty is an import-channel levy and posts through engine.tax's 'import-duties' instrument — see ASM- (logged) and engine.tax's own escalation (the dedicated fuel-duty instrument is an open Aaron reconciliation, not yet in data/tax_instruments.json).

forecourt.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): forecourt network coverage target — 'a growing city needs forecourts like it needs substations' (§49). Coverage adequacy = forecourts / (population/1000 × target).

tanker.comment: Directional placeholder (ASM-307, pending Aaron's balance pass): port tank farm / refinery tanker supply throughput in litres per tick. Equals total liquid-fuel demand at 0% EV (200000+80000+120000+40000) so the baseline is 'just supplied'; a §49 fuel shortage is modelled by cutting this throughput below demand.
